definitions.translation_difficulty: Mean per-model wrong-draw rate on a clear statement. An unparseable or non-equivalent translation counts as wrong.
definitions.pair_difficulty: Mean translation error rate of the clear statements sharing this pair_id. The same baseline applies to all members of the pair.
definitions.reading_coverage: Fraction of distinct retained gold formulas matched by at least one draw, using Spot semantic equivalence. Computed separately per model on ambiguous statements.
definitions.structural_complexity: Clear statement features. Words are whitespace-delimited and propositions are counted from the supplied mapping. Operator count includes Boolean and temporal operators in the gold AST. Temporal depth is the largest number of temporal operators on a root-to-leaf path.
definitions.ambiguous_translation_difficulty: A draw is correct if it is semantically equivalent to any retained gold formula. Unparseable draws count as wrong. Error rate is wrong draws divided by all draws.
definitions.translation_difficulty_level: Apply the fixed difficulty bands to the statement's wrong-draw rate. The first upper bound at or above the error rate determines the level.
definitions.pair_difficulty_level: Apply the same bands to the mean error rate of the pair's clear statements. Every statement in the pair shares this level.
definitions.difficulty_excluding_model: For each named held-out model, recompute the statement and pair error rates and levels using the other models' draws.

intermittently_difficult.label: Intermittently difficult
intermittently_difficult.rule: At least one wrong translation, and every model gets at least one right.

consistently_difficult_for_some_models.label: Consistently difficult for some models
consistently_difficult_for_some_models.rule: One or two models get all ten draws wrong.

consistently_difficult_across_models.label: Consistently difficult across models
consistently_difficult_across_models.rule: At least three models get all ten draws wrong.
